known_secrets.text: Certain Signs consistently appear at the end of sequences, possibly marking a title or place.
The Signs carved on the oldest Citadel brick differ subtly from those on newer, post-Turning brick.
Elira's tally-records use a simplified numeric version of some Signs, the closest thing to a confirmed meaning he has found.
Fen brought him an uncatalogued Sign sequence from the Old Canal Bed that may predate the rest of the settlement.
He cannot actually read the script, and is honest about this despite the disappointment it causes others.

unknowns: The true meaning of the Signs
Whether the Sign-style shift reflects a language change or just different carvers
What the older Sign sequence from the Old Canal Bed fragment truly says
